items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Sections 2.1 and 3.1.4 exclude theft, and sections 4.3(d)–(f) independently exclude personal articles taken from a car away from the insured location. The payable threshold is €0 before any deductible; €1 is a required positive placeholder.
Section 4.3(e) excludes the car, and section 5.2.5 excludes vehicle-related expenses. The payable threshold is €0 before any deductible; €1 is a required positive placeholder.
